- Frogeye_leaf_spot reference (Dise_2): circular spots on green leaves — distribution pattern closely matches the test image.
- Bacterial_Pustule: completely different mosaic/cracked brown texture pattern.
- Soybean_rust reference: field-wide defoliation, not the close-up spot pattern seen here.

The test image best matches **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: numerous circular lesions with defined dark margins on an otherwise green leaf. The spot shape, size range, and distribution align with the Frogeye reference.
